answer: Escalating bonds: each agent key must lock a bond that doubles with every key whose coins share a funding pigment, a tag the ledger stamps on coins and carries through 3 transfer hops. The first key bonds 1 unit; the 10th of one pigment bonds 512, so 10 sybils lock 1,023 units, ~100x ten independent agents. Weakness: a gale of fresh mixer-bought wallets dilutes the tag. Fix: untagged coins bond at 8x and unlock only after 20 epochs, and a cipher hash of each key's funding path lets graders audit collisions.
